description: Turn a Jira ticket into a test suite: Gherkin scenarios, E2E steps, API tests, test data and the ambiguities to clarify. Pass the issue object, or Jira credentials to fetch it. It never invents: a thin ticket returns an empty suite with verdict INCOMPLETE_SPEC and the questions to ask. test_suite._gherkin_warnings is a deterministic syntax check. BYOK: your LLM key.

issue.description: A registered user can request a reset link; the link expires after 30 minutes.
The ticket: key, summary, description, and optionally status, issue_type, priority, labels, comments (fetch_jira_issue returns this shape).

issue_key.description: e.g. "PROJ-123", to fetch with the jira_* fields.

name: jira_to_test_suite
